oḍḍana: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + yu. ] (na) CL=7 [Dhātvattha. 150. Nirutti, nhā. 393. See also - Uḍḍeti.] (1) Sets up (a net, trap, hint). Makes first and foremost. (Ti) (2) Can be set up.
oḍḍayantu: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi)+antu] (kri) CL=7 They fix (a hint, snare, trap, the body, etc.,).
oḍḍenta: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + anta] (ti) CL=7 One who sets up (a hint, snare, trap, the body, etc.,). (saddattha.) One who causes to happen or arise. (adhippāyattha.).
oḍḍentu: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + antu] (kri) CL=7 May they set up (a hint, snare, trap, the body, etc.,). See - Oḍḍeti.
oḍḍeti: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + a+ ti] (kri) CL=7 He sets up (a hint, snare, trap, the body).
oḍḍetuṃ: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To set up (a hint, snare, trap, the body, etc.,).
oḍḍetvā: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having set up (a hint, snare, trap, the body, etc.,).
oḍḍha: [vaha + ta. ] (pu, na) CL=7 [Uḍha(saṃ). Oḍha(pākata)] The wealth that is stolen. With the package of the wealth that is stolen.
oḍḍi: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + ī. ] (kri) CL=7 [Dhātvattha. 150. Pārā, gaṃ, saca, 2. 461.] He established or set up. He made first and foremost. See - Oḍḍeti.
oḍḍita: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Should be set up or laid down. (2) Should be placed in a dangling position.
oḍḍitaniyāma: [oḍḍita + niyāma] (pu) CL=7 The way or method that is set up. A way of setting up.
oḍḍitapāsa: [oḍḍita + pāsa] (pu) CL=7 A snare or trap that sets up.
oḍḍitavālapāsa: [oḍḍita + vālapāsa] (pu) CL=7 A trap that should be set up.
oḍḍiya: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 To set up (a hint, snare, trap, the body, etc.,).
oḍḍiyitvā: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 To set up (a hint, snare, trap, the body, etc.,). See - Oḍḍiya.
oḍḍāpeti: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + ṇāpe + ti] (kā, kri) CL=7 Causes to fix or aim or direct. Causes to scatter. Throws down.
oḍḍetu: [u(ava) + ḍī(ḍi) + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To set up (a hint, snare, trap, the body, etc.,).
